quests.title: Worm's Head
quests.summary: Cross to the Worm on the tide and see what breathes at the blowhole.

steps.text: Read the tide table with the coastwatch volunteer at Rhossili and cross the causeway in time.
Prove yourself to Gwen of the Worm on the Low Neck.
Listen at the blowhole on the Outer Head, and catch what answers.
Tell the coastwatch volunteer at Rhossili what you found.

quests.reward: A Hag Stone, laverbread, standing in Wales, and an Ormwyrm.

quests.title: Under Milk Wood
quests.summary: Find four of Dylan Thomas's voices rehearsing around Swansea for the Centre's reading.

steps.text: Find blind Captain Cat, dreaming by the boats in the marina.
Find Polly Garter, singing over her washing in the Mumbles.
Find Organ Morgan, practising in the No Sign Bar on Wind Street.
Find Mrs Ogmore-Pritchard, polishing on Cwmdonkin Drive.
Report back to the curator at the Dylan Thomas Centre.

quests.reward: A signed copy of Under Milk Wood, Welsh cakes and standing in Wales.

quests.title: Cockles for Breakfast
quests.summary: Fetch fresh cockles from Penclawdd for a proper Swansea breakfast.

steps.text: Find Dilys on the cockle beds at Penclawdd, on Gower's north shore.
Rake and riddle a bag of cockles the proper way.
Take the cockles back to Megan in Swansea Market.

quests.reward: A laverbread breakfast to take away, Welsh cakes and standing in Wales.
